title: Regular quantum annulus unitary dilation and applications
summary: Consider the annulus $\mathbb{A}_r=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:r^{-1} 1$ and the quantum annulus \[ Q\mathbb{A}_r=\{T:\ T \text{ is an invertible operator and} \ \|T\|, \|T^{-1}\|\leq r\}. \] McCullough and Pascoe proved that $T\in Q\mathbb{A}_r$ if and only if $β(T^*,T)=(r^2+r^{-2})-T^*T-(T^*T)^{-1}\ge0$. We call an invertible operator $T$ a quantum annulus unitary if $β(T^*,T)=0$. In this article, we construct an explicit doubly commuting $d$-tuple of quantum annulus unitaries that simultaneously extends a given doubly commuting $d$-tuple of operators in $Q\mathbb{A}_r$.
